name: Toronto Kidz Summer Camp
hours: Full day; before/after care 8 AM - 5:30 PM (extra fee)
activities: Weekly themed activities (Dinosaur, Space, Pirates, Underwater World, Dragons & Unicorns), arts & crafts, games, field trips to CN Tower, ROM, Casa Loma, Aquarium, Little Canada.
notes: Mimico location is a 5-min drive from home! Field trips, transportation, and entry tickets all included in the $79/day price.

name: CampTO (City of Toronto)
closestLocation: Nearest community centre in South Etobicoke (check toronto.ca for specific sites)
activities: Arts & crafts, drama, music, dance, active games, nature, science, cooking. Specialty options include visual/performing arts, science, creative writing, magic, French immersion.
notes: 170 locations means there's likely one within 10 min of home. Welcome Policy subsidies available. Free mid-morning snack (new 2026). Register ASAP — Early Local registration is NOW!

name: Brick Works Academy
price: 25% deposit at application, balance due May 1
activities: LEGO WeDo 1.0 & 2.0, crafts, experiments, play-based learning, computational thinking.
registration: Contact: director@brickworksacademy.com (age verified with birth certificate)
notes: Must be 5 and have attended JK. Kingsway location is very close to home! LEGO robotics focus.

name: Children's Arts Theatre School (CATS)
price: $100 non-refundable deposit. 5% sibling discount. Extended care $5/day (5-6 PM)
activities: Junior Camp: storytelling, pantomime, improvisation, creative movement, tableaux, visual arts, voice. Semi-professional show on last day.
notes: High Park location is 10 min away. Age 4 confirmed for Junior Camp. Kids perform a real show for parents on the last day!

name: Mad Science Toronto
ageNote: Ontario JK starts at age 4; confirm with camp that JK-age children are accepted (some camps mean SK/age 5 by 'kindergarten')
activities: Dedicated Kindergarten Camp: hands-on science with dinosaurs, bubbling potions, erupting volcanoes, slime, space. Daily experiments & take-home activities. Also Chess + Science and Travel the World Through Art.
notes: Call to confirm if JK-age (4) qualifies or if they require SK (5). Mississauga location is closest at ~15 min.

name: Harbourfront Centre Summer Camps
locations: Harbourfront Centre, 235 Queens Quay W, Toronto
activities: Young Campers (4-6): movement, arts, outdoor discovery, creativity. Also Improv Theatre (Second City), Science & Engineering (Ontario Science Centre), Visual Arts, Performing Arts, Marine programs. 20+ programs.
registration: Running since 1979. Extended Care, Meal Plans, Busing add-ons available.
notes: Premium waterfront location. Age 4 confirmed for Young Campers program. Partnership with Second City and Ontario Science Centre for specialty weeks.

name: STEM Camp
locations: Church of our Saviour, 1 Laurentide Dr, North York
hours: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; before-care 7:30 AM ($40/wk); after-care 5:30 PM ($40/wk)
activities: Coding with Minecraft, programming robots, building models, science experiments, LEGO activities. 4 rotating themes including Minecraft: Quest for the Ender Portal and LEGO: The Legend of the Brick Keeper.
notes: Not-for-profit. Age 4 confirmed (must be 4 by Jan 1). Downtown location is closer (~20 min); North York is ~30 min.

name: AGO Summer Art Camp
locations: Art Gallery of Ontario, 317 Dundas St W, Toronto
hours: Full day; Extended Care 8:00-8:30 AM & 4:00-5:30 PM
price: Member discount available. Financial assistance/subsidy program (1 week per camper)
activities: Drawing, painting, collage, sculpture, printmaking, cartooning, animation. Programs: Art Rebels, Wild Things, Build It, Miniature Worlds, Art and Play.
notes: Must be 5. World-class art gallery setting. Financial assistance available for one week per camper.

name: Codezilla Kids
activities: STEM/STEAM curriculum, coding, logic, problem-solving. Age 5-10 focus on STEAM; coding camps for 8+.
registration: Opened January 16, 2026. 12-15 spots max per session. Scholarships available.
notes: Must be 5. Junction location is closest (~15 min). Small group sizes (12-15 max). Scholarships available.

name: Young People's Theatre (YPT) Summer Drama Camp
locations: 161 Frederick St & 165 Front St East, Toronto
price: Not confirmed. Bursaries available (Slaight Family Foundation)
activities: Drama games, acting, voice, movement, character creation, improvisation. Campers create and perform an original play on the YPT stage.
notes: Requires Senior Kindergarten (age 5+). NOT for JK/age 4. Kids perform on a real professional theatre stage. Bursaries available.

closestLocation: Toronto location (check website for exact address)
activities: Creative and exercise-based programs combining physical activity with arts.

registration: Check website for 2026 pricing and registration
